question.knowledge_point: Solving Exponential Equations Containing Different Bases by Rewriting One Exponent
question.worked_solution:
To solve this equation, we need both exponential terms to have a common base.

To do this, we write $64$ as ${8}^{2},$ and then we rewrite the right-hand side using the power rule of exponents:

$$
\begin{aligned}{8}^{5a-12} & =\frac{1}{{64}^{a+4}} \\ {8}^{5a-12} & =\frac{1}{{({8}^{2})}^{a+4}} \\ {8}^{5a-12} & =\frac{1}{{8}^{2(a+4)}}\end{aligned}
$$

Next, we rewrite the right-hand side using a negative exponent: 

$$
\begin{aligned}{8}^{5a-12} & ={8}^{-2(a+4)}\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, since both sides of the equation share the same base $(8)$, we equate the exponents and solve for $a:$

$$
\begin{aligned}5a-12 & =-2(a+4) \\ 5a-12 & =-2a-8 \\ 7a & =4 \\ a & =\frac{4}{7}\end{aligned}
$$

question.knowledge_point: Solving Exponential Equations Containing Different Bases by Rewriting One Exponent
question.worked_solution:
To solve this equation, we need both exponential terms to have a common base.

To do this, we write $16$ as ${4}^{2},$ and then rewrite the right-hand side using the power rule of exponents:

$$
\begin{aligned}{4}^{x+4} & ={16}^{x} \\ {4}^{x+4} & ={({4}^{2})}^{x} \\ {4}^{x+4} & ={4}^{2x}\end{aligned}
$$

Now, since both sides of the equation share the same base $(4)$, we equate the exponents and solve for $x:$

$$
\begin{aligned}x+4 & =2x \\ x & =4\end{aligned}
$$

question.knowledge_point: Solving Exponential Equations Containing Different Bases by Rewriting Two Exponents
question.worked_solution:
To solve this equation, we need both exponential terms to have a common base. To do this, we rewrite the equation using $81={3}^{4}$ and $27={3}^{3},$ as follows:

$$
{({3}^{4})}^{3m}={({3}^{3})}^{m+5}\,
$$

Then, we apply the power rule of exponents. This gives:

$$
\begin{aligned}{3}^{12m} & ={3}^{3(m+5)}\end{aligned}
$$

Now, since both sides of the equation share the same base $(3)$, we equate the exponents and solve for $m:$

$$
\begin{aligned}12m & =3(m+5) \\ 12m & =3m+15 \\ 9m & =15 \\ m & =\frac{5}{3}\end{aligned}
$$
